The Chinese characters for Jacob

As a transliteration, Jacob is usually written 雅各布 (Yǎ gè bù). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

雅
Yǎ
elegant, refined
各
gè
each
布
bù
cloth, spread

Origin and meaning

From Hebrew, Jacob carries the meaning “supplanter”.

About the name Jacob

In the Bible, Jacob was the patriarch whose twelve sons founded the tribes of Israel.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Jacob carries the meaning “supplanter” and looks striking in brush strokes.
